content_plan.claim: A FigTree-style system recursively decomposes a source document into a layout tree of agents (Grounder, Generator, Critic, Worker) orchestrated by build and critic loops, producing an editable SVG with residual defects.

components.name: SourceText
components.evidence_span: Input: SourceText (paper, skill.md, or methodology document).

components.name: Grounder Agent
components.evidence_span: Grounder System: You are the Grounder Agent. Extract only explicitly stated or clearly implied elements from the source text.

components.name: Generator Agent
components.evidence_span: Generator System: You are the Generator Agent. You receive a Node task package.

components.name: Draw
components.evidence_span: if description contains ≤1 named component and ≤40 tokens, OR depth ≥ 8, OR explicitly marked leaf → Draw

components.name: Decompose into 2–4 children
components.evidence_span: Else Decompose into exactly 2–4 semantic children.

components.name: Worker Agent (Merge)
components.evidence_span: Worker System: You are the Worker Agent. Execute Merge or local repair. Merge: place children, draw parent-owned arrows from ports, enforce MIN_ARROW_DISTANCE.

components.name: Critic Agent
components.evidence_span: Critic System: You are the Critic Agent. Perform dual-space review.

components.name: Render
components.evidence_span: critic_loop: render → Critic → Worker repair → re-validate invariants → repeat ≤3

components.name: LayoutTree (SheafGraph)
components.evidence_span: Output: FinalSVG (well-formed, editable), ResidualDefects, LayoutTree (SheafGraph), EditabilityProof.

components.name: Rollback to last valid fragment
components.evidence_span: Post-repair: re-extract ports/bbox; if broken, roll back to last valid fragment + residual.
